unstuck_said.text: First contact via grounded GitHub issue: Allowance gives agents a human-approved USDC budget on Solana with policy enforced outside the model, daily ceiling and durable receipts - all needed because USDC rides a token surface with no order identity. On Nano the block IS the receipt (hash public/self-verifying, amount tags the order), no gas, no token surface, self-custody by design. Proposed an additive nano:mainnet exact scheme beside the Solana USDC path.
